live.count: {count, plural, one {# reading now} other {# reading now}}

home.title: Documents
home.desc: Share a document by link and see who read each page.
home.emptyBody: Upload a PDF, a PowerPoint, a Word file or a video, make a link for each person and see what they read.

new.title: New document
new.desc: The file stays private. People see it only through a link you make.
new.dropTitle: Choose a file or drop it here
new.dropHint: Documents up to {doc} MB, video up to {video} GB, within the workspace's storage
new.formats: PDF is shown exactly as it is. Word (.docx) and PowerPoint (.pptx) go through a simplified converter: check the preview, and export to PDF when the layout matters. Old .doc and .ppt, Excel, Keynote and password-protected PDFs are not supported. Video: MP4, WebM or MOV.
new.docsNote: The page is copied as it is now, into a PDF. To share later edits, replace the file. Pages with characters outside Latin alphabets can't be converted yet.
new.docsUnavailable: You don't have access to Docs.
new.titlePlaceholder: The file name, if you leave it empty

detail.sharing: Who in the workspace sees it
detail.replaceToFix: Replace the file to fix it.
detail.simplified_word: Converted with a simplified layout: text, headings, lists, tables and images, on plain pages. Check the preview. For an exact copy, export to PDF and replace the file.
detail.simplified_slides: Converted with a simplified renderer: charts, SmartArt, gradients and effects don't appear, and every font is drawn in one family. Check the preview. For an exact copy, export to PDF and replace the file.
detail.deleteBody: Its links stop working now, and its files, versions and numbers are deleted. This can't be undone.

versions.title: Versions
versions.help: Replacing the file keeps every link. A visit always counts for the version it saw, and links switch when the new file is ready.
versions.label: Version {n}
versions.replaced: File replaced. Links show the new version.

link.title: Links
link.empty: No links yet. Make one for each person or campaign to see who opens what.
link.emptyNotReady: Links appear when the document is ready.
link.name: Name
link.nameHelp: Only you see it, to tell links apart.
link.recipientHelp: If someone opens it with another email, the visit is marked as possibly forwarded.
link.requireEmailHelp: A typed email isn't proof of who it is, and shows as not verified.
link.verifyEmail: Verify the email with a code
link.verifyHelp: We send a code to that address, and it only works in the same browser.
link.verifyForced: An allow list needs it: otherwise typing a listed email would be enough.
link.passcodeKeep: Leave empty to keep the current one
link.accessList: Allow or block emails and domains
link.accessAllowHelp: One per line, or import a CSV: emails and domains are taken from any cell. A domain includes its subdomains. Up to 500.
link.accessBlockHelp: One per line. Without verification, someone blocked can type another email.
link.downloadOn: People get the original file, with the watermark if the link has one. A PowerPoint or Word original keeps its hidden slides, notes and comments: turn on the watermark, or export to PDF first.
link.downloadOff: PDF, Word and PowerPoint reach the browser as page images, never as the file. A video is streamed, so someone determined can save it. A screenshot can't be stopped.
link.watermarkHelp: Drawn into each page image on the server, with the date and time. It discourages sharing but doesn't stop a screenshot. On video it's only drawn over the player.
link.ndaHelp: Each person signs their own copy in Sign. Only templates with one signer appear here.
link.ndaEmpty: To ask for a signed NDA, make a Sign template with one signer.
link.notify: Tell me when someone starts reading
link.disabledToast: Link disabled. It stops working now.
link.deleteBody: It stops working now and can't come back. Its visits stay in the document's numbers.
link.verifyForcedNda: An agreement needs it: otherwise anyone could sign as someone else.
link.problem_creator_left: The person who made this link left the workspace. Make a new link.
link.problem_creator_no_access: The person who made this link no longer has Send. Give them access again, or make a new link.
link.problem_document_private: The document is private, so this link can't show it. Share the document with the workspace, or make a new link.
link.problem_space_nothing_visible: The documents in this space are private to others, so this link has nothing to show. Share them with the workspace, or make a new link.
link.csvSkipped: {count, plural, one {Skipped # cell that is not an email or a domain.} other {Skipped # cells that are not an email or a domain.}}
link.csvTooMany: The list is over {max}: remove some before saving.

visits.empty: No visits yet. A visit counts when someone reads for a few seconds in a browser: link previews and bots don't count.
visits.howMeasured: Time is measured in the reader's browser with the tab visible, and stops after 2 minutes with no activity. A page counts as seen after 1 second. Location comes from the IP address and is approximate; a VPN shows the VPN's location.
visits.perPage: Average time per page in version {n}, and how many visits got there
visits.deniedTitle: Tried to open it without access

spaces.title: Spaces
spaces.desc: Several documents behind one link, with numbers per document and access per person.
spaces.emptyBody: Put a deck, a contract and the numbers behind one link, and see what each person opened.
spaces.docsEmpty: Add the documents this space shares.
spaces.docsEmptyNoDocs: Upload a document first, and add it here when it's ready.
spaces.accessHelp: Once someone is on this list, the space closes: only listed people get in, with a verified email, and each sees only the documents you pick. With an empty list, everyone with a link sees all the space.
spaces.accessEmpty: No list: everyone with a link sees all the space.
spaces.deleteBody: Its links stop working now. The documents stay in Send, and they keep their numbers.
spaces.sharing: Who in the workspace sees it
spaces.lastAccessBody: With an empty list the space opens again: everyone with a link sees all of it, with no verification.

settings.title: Send settings
settings.desc: The brand people see when they open a link.
settings.logoHelp: A public image at an https:// address, ideally a transparent PNG. The viewer loads it without sending which link was opened.
settings.colorHelp: Used for the main buttons of the viewer.

viewer.metaDescription: Open this link in a browser to view it.
viewer.disabledTitle: This link is no longer active
viewer.closedBody: Ask the person who sent it for a new one.
viewer.passcodeBody: The person who sent this link set a passcode.
viewer.emailBody: The person who sent this link asks for your email.
viewer.emailBodyVerify: We'll send a code to this address to confirm it's yours.
viewer.deniedBody: {email} can't open this link. Ask the person who sent it.
viewer.trackingNotice: The sender can see when this was opened and how long each part was viewed.
viewer.ndaBody: You need to sign an agreement before viewing this. It opens in a new tab.
viewer.ndaWaiting: When you finish signing, this page continues by itself.
viewer.emptyBody: The person who sent this link hasn't shared a document with you.
viewer.videoError: The video didn't load. Some browsers can't play MOV files.
viewer.unavailableTitle: This link is no longer available

errors.forbidden: You don't have permission for that.
errors.unauthorized: Your session ended. Sign in again.
errors.invalid_input: Check the data and try again.
errors.storage_unavailable: File storage isn't set up on this server.
errors.unsupported_type: That file type isn't supported. Use PDF, .docx, .pptx, MP4, WebM or MOV.
errors.file_too_large: That file is over the limit.
errors.content_mismatch: The file isn't what its name says. Export it again and retry.
errors.video_unreadable: This browser can't read that video. Try MP4.
errors.upload_incomplete: Part of the file didn't arrive. Upload it again.
errors.invalid_part: Part of the file didn't arrive. Upload it again.
errors.pdf_password: This PDF has a password. Remove it and upload it again: the link can have its own passcode.
errors.pdf_invalid: This PDF is damaged or can't be read.
errors.pdf_too_complex: This PDF is too complex to process. Print it to a new PDF and upload that.
errors.too_many_pages: This file has more than 500 pages.
errors.office_invalid: This file is damaged or can't be read. Export it to PDF and upload that.
errors.office_unicode: This Word file has characters we can't convert yet, outside Latin alphabets. Export it to PDF and upload that.
errors.docs_unicode: This page has characters we can't convert yet, outside Latin alphabets.
errors.docs_unavailable: You don't have access to Docs.
errors.render_failed: We couldn't process this file. Export it to PDF again and retry.
errors.file_unavailable: The file isn't available right now.
errors.invalid_passcode: The passcode needs at least 6 characters.
errors.invalid_access_entry: One of the entries isn't an email or a domain.
errors.empty_access_list: Add at least one email or domain to the list.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes.
errors.code_expired: That code expired. Ask for another one.
errors.email_failed: We couldn't send the email. Try again.
errors.not_on_this_step: Reload the page and try again.
errors.gate_required: Reload the page and try again.
errors.link_disabled: This link is no longer active.
errors.nda_unavailable: The agreement isn't available. Ask the person who sent the link.
errors.nda_template_invalid: The agreement needs a template with one signer.
errors.render_unavailable: This server can't prepare pages right now. The file is safe and we keep retrying.
errors.office_too_complex: This file is too large to convert. Export it to PDF and upload that.
errors.storage_quota: This would go over the workspace's storage limit. Delete documents to make room.
errors.logo_https: The logo needs an https:// address: the viewer only loads secure images.
errors.page_too_complex: A page in this file is too heavy to prepare. Print it to a new PDF, or lower its detail, and upload that.
errors.csv_too_large: That file is over 1 MB. A list of emails is much smaller.
errors.too_many_entries: The list has more than 500 entries.
